reason: An authentication reverse-proxy utility that places a login gateway in front of the DeepSeek Harness Web interface and proxies authenticated web, API, and WebSocket traffic.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供带管理员登录、会话管理以及网页、API 和 WebSocket 代理功能的认证网关。
summaries.en: Provides an administrator login gateway for DeepSeek Harness Web with session management and proxying for web pages, APIs, and WebSocket traffic.

capabilities: Provides a login page and administrator account setup
Stores a salted password hash and server-side session state
Authenticates HTTP, API, and WebSocket requests
Proxies DSH Web pages, assets, API requests, and WebSocket upgrades
Listens on a configurable local gateway port
